caption: The drawing depicts an upturned umbrella with a light brown wooden handle and a metal frame. The umbrella canopy is made of a fabric rendered in shades of gray and light purple with decorative bands featuring circular patterns in a light beige color. The canopy appears tattered, with frayed and uneven edges. The spokes of the umbrella frame are exposed and radiate outward from the central shaft, which has a fabric tie or ribbon attached to it. The handle of the umbrella is curved in a classic cane shape and has three small red dots along its length. The umbrella is positioned at an angle, slightly tilted to the left. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset sketch showing a simplified line-drawing of the umbrella with dimensions marked as “19” and “10”.” The drawing is outlined with a thin red line forming a border near the edge of the beige background, which has some visible brushstroke textures along the borders. The artist’s signature and date are visible at the bottom right.
title: Doll Parasol
